description.value:
From Hanged Man · Price: you need a reflective surface, such as a mirror, water or polished metal.

Theme Space

  • 1: Your stand can move from one reflection to another within its range as if it were a single space, and it can be in a reflection to attack the creature reflected there. A Strike from a reflection makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against it.
  • 5: Strikes from a reflection gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage per weapon damage die. Surge, 1 action: your stand strikes from the reflection in a creature's own eyes: a Strike that deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[slashing]] damage instead of its normal damage, the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against it.
  • 9: You can see through any reflection within 60 ft.
  • 13: Surge: your stand jumps between up to three reflections, making a Strike from each against different creatures.
  • 17: While in a reflection, your stand can only be targeted by creatures that can see that reflection.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
